description: The US economic calendar from the agencies' own schedules: when BLS (jobs, CPI, PPI, JOLTS), BEA (GDP, personal income and PCE, trade), the Census Bureau (retail sales, housing starts, durable goods) and the Fed (FOMC decisions) release, with times in US Eastern and the market-moving releases flagged.

key_only.description: Only the releases markets watch most (jobs, CPI, PPI, JOLTS, GDP, PCE, retail sales, housing starts, durable goods, trade, the employment cost index, FOMC decisions).

until.description: Last date; default 30 days after since.

name: economic_calendar

outputSchema.description: rows are releases in date and time order (US Eastern); key marks the market-moving ones.

title: Economic calendar
